summary: Fixed the Calendar smoke test, which today's subscribers change broke and which would have blocked merges. Fixed Notifications: switching channel there now marks that channel's items read.
why: Smoke tests on main failed 2 of 127 (the Calendar tooltip wording changed). A code review of Notifications found a bug: the bell kept counting after a channel switch. Each fix has a smoke test. tsc, lint and build pass; smoke tests 129 passed, 5 skipped.

findings.title: Calendar smoke test out of date
findings.detail: The day tooltip now says 'views, likes and subscribers'; the test expected 'views and likes', so it failed on desktop and phone.

findings.title: Notifications stayed unread after a channel switch
findings.detail: The page marked items seen once per visit; switching channel refetched without reloading, so the new channel's items were never marked.

findings.title: Calendar month cards stack on a phone
findings.detail: Four cards one per row push the calendar below the first screen; added as an idea (2x2 on phones).

changes.title: Calendar smoke test follows the subscribers wording
changes.detail: Also checks the month's Subscribers card and each week's subscribers line.

changes.title: Notifications: switched-to channel's items marked read
changes.detail: Marked items are remembered by id instead of once per visit; new smoke test.
